subject: CONFIRMED: terminal NATIVE_COVER can be followed by accepted old-cycle Gen4 reassert/reconcile
body: CONFIRMED against current main bfbf5d68fc84cab62cadcbc0b6bc5eefbc7ba5ea / runtime source f9ba2ca7afa2e67586231770fd8b0abe56b94b5b: Fold7ContinuityCoordinator.onTopologyChanged() calls onTopologyFastLane(reason), which can transition the controller to NATIVE_COVER and enqueue ReleaseSecondary -> releaseCoverLease(return intent), then unconditionally calls reconcileCoverLease(topology:reason) with a newer panelIntentSequence. Both app-side commands are launched independently on Dispatchers.IO. Separately, an already-in-flight ensureCoverRouteHeld() reassert has no post-result terminal-state/close-cycle fence before accepting the shell snapshot. The daemon serializes mutation on coverMutationExecutor and rejects stale intentSequence, but this only orders ARRIVAL, not semantic priority. Therefore a newer reconcile/reassert may be accepted before the terminal return arrives, preserving/reviving the prior close-cycle owner; the older return can then be rejected stale. Field evidence matches this schedule: cycle 10 reaches NATIVE_COVER generation 83 at 05:35:07.774Z, then an accepted route reassert for old generation 80/closeCycle 10 reports PREWARM_IN_FLIGHT at 05:35:08.690Z; repeated topology reconciles remain PREWARM_IN_FLIGHT; the delayed generation-83 return later appears with stale-shell-revision. A similar post-terminal reassert pattern occurs in the previous close cycle. CONFIRMED defect: terminal state is not a semantic fence against already-launched route work or the same callback’s follow-on reconcile. STRONG HYPOTHESIS: this defect contributes to the field black/unresponsive cover and repeated 30-70 degree oscillation failures. Recommended smallest safe fix: (1) after fast-lane reduction, reconcile only while controller is still in secondary/prewarm states; never enqueue a general reconcile after entering terminal NATIVE_COVER; (2) fence reassert completion against captured closeCycle/generation and current secondary controller state before accepting/updating readiness; (3) establish a terminal-return fence that suppresses old-cycle prepare/reassert/reconcile until a genuinely new close cycle starts; (4) preferably serialize app-side Gen4 panel commands through one ordered actor/executor and allocate intentSequence inside that queue. Preserve all current close thresholds/geometry. Required adversarial test: pending old-cycle reassert + terminal return + topology reconcile under every arrival/completion ordering must always end native and must never re-enter PREWARM_IN_FLIGHT for the retired cycle.
